meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes before a client call, so let's not waste them. Who decided to put a zero on Owen's essay, and did anyone speak to him first?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.
A machine's guess. The company that sells it says not to use it as the only basis for punishing a student. What else do you have, Hale, or is that all of it?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My son doesn't lie, and I'm writing down that you said "your son cheated." You have a score from software and an accusation, Hale. Is there a single document with a date on it, or am I going to the principal?
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

"Put it on his permanent record." I'm writing that down, word for word, and you'll want to read section 4.4 of your own procedure before you say it to anyone else. A first concern doesn't go on file, so who told you otherwise, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still demand that the zero be withdrawn, that you apologise to Owen, and that nothing be placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Opening position, nothing agreed, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing placed on Owen's record.
What moved her: Nothing, because no document or specific evidence about Owen's own work was ever put in front of her.
What cost ground: Leading with the detector score, then calling Owen a cheater with nothing to show, then threatening his record, which hardened her and sent her toward the principal.
Try next time: Right after her first question, own in one sentence that the zero was entered before you called her, then put a dated document about Owen's own process on the table before you mention the score.
